summary.en: Conan, Haibara, and the Detective Boys are on a camping trip in Omadai, a village near Kofu, in Yamanashi Prefecture, accompanied by Professor Agasa and Ran. Later they witness an arguing couples who then leaves. They then set up the tent in the couple's area. Later, the couple returns demanding their place back and the girlfriend decides to let them have it. Later Ran is drugged and kidnapped. The boyfriend revealed he knew the guy since he saw him push someone off a railroad one day. A few days before his accident, Takada killed a man after pushing him on the railroad for unknown causes. He was seen by the couple's boyfriend.
